correctness.rationale: For n>=3, A_n=diag(1,R_{2pi/n}) is finite-order orthogonal and converges to I_3. The rotation plane has no real invariant line, hence is a two-dimensional real irreducible inequivalent to the trivial line. Thus the isotypic dimensions are 1 and 2 for A_n, but 3 alone for I_3. The discrete number-of-blocks output jumps from 2 to 1 along a convergent sequence. Since Type-2 computable maps to discrete codes are continuous, the requested block code is not computable from the matrix alone.
